method: Visible scene-graph inventory after real material batching and instancing. fixture.baseline: Fresh source-only git archive of the named commit; features, lib, scripts and package manifests only. Shared installed node_modules via symlink. No environment files, persisted state, databases or uploads copied. Temporary baseline removed after measurement.
fixture.modelOptions: Production createSpacecraft(THREE) defaults; home at time 0, delta 0, immediate doors; wide and compact layouts measured independently.
fixture.supplementalInventory: Same production model state. traverseVisible counts retained Object3D nodes, mesh objects, material-group submission candidates and geometry arrays; records four pressure structures and cabin utilities plus ladder, docking, service and exterior-chassis groups. Includes shared architectural/camera framing metadata and exported composition constants.

interpretation.visibleObjects: Visible retained Object3D nodes including groups, lights and mesh objects after production batching. Not the count of authored parts or interaction targets.
interpretation.triangles: Geometry submission potential with instance multiplicity, before camera culling. Not measured per-pass GPU triangles.
interpretation.meshes: Visible scene-graph mesh count after production batching, a potential submission count. Not a renderer draw-call measurement.
interpretation.meshSubmissionUnits: Potential single-pass material submissions before frustum culling: one per visible mesh with a single material, or per visible material group intersecting drawRange for an array of materials. Instancing is one unit. No WebGL renderer, shadow or AO pass is run; these are structural candidates, not actual draws.
interpretation.attributeBytes: Sum of unique geometry attribute and index typed arrays retained in the visible scene graph. Excludes textures, instance transforms, JavaScript object overhead, temporary construction allocations, driver storage and total process/GPU memory.
interpretation.arrayCounts: Geometry attributes and index arrays counted once per unique BufferGeometry, using the same geometry-identity deduplication as the existing inventory. Shared geometry across separate assembly totals prevents summing assembly bytes into a whole-scene total.
interpretation.rendering: Node fixture omits document/canvas-created text and display artwork and uses no actual WebGL rendering. Identical omissions apply to both variants.
interpretation.noTimingClaims: No frame timing, startup/decode/upload measurements, thermal/power/battery observations or performance gain claimed. Design work establishes a new baseline; held optimization candidates remain held.

matchingEvidence: For finite before/after captures, manifest.baselineRevision must equal baselineRevision here. Every manifest.versions.before/after.transitiveSources entry must match the same path in sourceHashes.before/after.files. The fixture bundle hash identifies its lighting/camera code separately. Any runtime source change requires remeasurement and refreshed affected captures; test-only edits do not change this source set.
